both VPI omapatrilat (which inhibits ACE and neutral endopeptidase 24.11) and ARB candesartan (which inhibits AT1Rs) attenuate adverse LV remodeling and improve LV function during healing after R MI, in part, by modulating matrix proteases, myeloperoxide, cytokines, iNOS, and TGFβ1.
